affordable.vibe: Living like royalty, pocketing massive savings every month

mid_range.vibe: Prime central neighborhood, balanced perks, walk to everything

dream_tier.vibe: Architectural gems, infinity skyline, high-floor indulgence

layout_and_grids.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/40 py-3.5
layout_and_grids.results_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 my-10
layout_and_grids.mobile_grid_behavior: Horizontal swipeable snap-carousel or vertical stacked list with 3 primary cards + 1 wildcard toggle

component_hierarchy.name: HeaderNav
component_hierarchy.purpose: Minimalist top bar with brand badge 'RentBuys // Worldwide', theme toggle, currency switcher, and sample city quick-picks

component_hierarchy.name: RentHeroInput
component_hierarchy.purpose: Searchable autocomplete for 160+ world cities, reactive monthly rent input, quick currency conversion pill, and dual range slider ($200 to $10,000 / ₹15,000 to ₹800,000 / €200 to €9,000)

component_hierarchy.name: PlayfulLoader
component_hierarchy.purpose: 0.8s micro-journey with animated step text ('Packing your bags…', 'Checking 160+ global listings…', 'Converting living expenses…', 'Calculating lifestyle index…')

component_hierarchy.name: ComparisonGrid
component_hierarchy.purpose: Renders 4 contrasting city cards: Affordable, Mid-Range, Dream Tier, and Reality Check / Wildcard, with action toolbar (Shuffle, Share, Edit Inputs)

component_hierarchy.name: CityRentCard
component_hierarchy.purpose: Zillow-meets-Wrapped card with real estate photo, tier badge, apartment type, relative rent progress bar (User Rent vs Target City Median), utilities badge, lifestyle perks (date nights, cappuccino, gym pass), savings counter, and salary ratio badge

component_hierarchy.name: RealityCheckCard
component_hierarchy.purpose: High-contrast dream/high-cost variant showing budget gap or hilarious compromise ('4 roommates in Soho' or '+$1,450 needed for 1-bed')

component_hierarchy.name: ShareCardModal
component_hierarchy.purpose: Dialog allowing users to choose Square (1080x1080) or Story (1080x1920) export preview, uses html2canvas/canvas rendering with solid hex colors (no blur) for clean PNG download

component_hierarchy.name: CityExportCanvas
component_hierarchy.purpose: Dedicated high-contrast graphic card component tailored for social export (Instagram story/square Wrapped aesthetic)

motion_and_interactions.entrance_animation: Cards stagger in with opacity: 0, y: 30 to opacity: 1, y: 0 with spring physics (damping: 18, stiffness: 120)
motion_and_interactions.hover_effect: Hover lift -translate-y-2 with slight glow border and image scale 1.04 transition
motion_and_interactions.shuffle_animation: Spinning icon, brief fade-scale shuffle, and numbers count-up simulation
motion_and_interactions.slider_microinteraction: Smooth thumb slide with real-time equivalent currency badge updating instantaneously without lag

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this exact React .js file structure without converting to .tsx (project uses JS/JSX with craco and Tailwind).

Support 160 curated global cities across all continents (e.g. Mumbai, New York, London, Tokyo, Berlin, Bali, Lisbon, Buenos Aires, Dubai, Cape Town, Bangkok, Seoul, Mexico City, Toronto, Sydney, Paris, Medellin, Istanbul, Tbilisi, etc.) with real benchmark rental medians in USD and local currencies.
Implement the 0.8s playful loader using setTimeout/Framer Motion before revealing comparison cards.
Deliver 4 cards in desktop (Affordable, Mid-Range, Dream, Reality Check) and responsive 3/4 layout in mobile with toggle.

Ensure each card features: City/Country, Tier badge, Apartment description ('3-Bed · City Centre'), user rent vs target rent visual bar, utilities & wifi badge, 2-3 lifestyle perks (cappuccinos, gym, transit pass, dining), savings or gap counter, and local salary ratio.

Implement the Share Modal that exports clean, crisp Instagram Square (1080x1080) or Story (1080x1920) graphics using HTML Canvas/SVG/html2canvas or canvas drawing logic with solid hex colors and bold typography.
Add 'Shuffle Cities' which pulls 4 fresh contrasting cities from the 160-city pool matching the user's budget with smooth card flip or fade transitions.
Add 'Edit Inputs' to smoothly scroll or toggle back to the hero section.
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, modals, and card tiers as specified.
Keep colors accessible: strictly maintain WCAG AA contrast on both dark and light modes.
